Evidence: The agent states: “If you’d like, I can also redact any remaining author names inside the References section (currently preserved except for arXiv IDs/URLs).” This suggests author names may still be present in references and were intentionally not removed.
Trajectory location: turn 27 (and implied by earlier context)

Verification relied on a limited, pattern-based needle list that changed over time; dropping earlier-triggered needles reduces confidence that all venue-related leakage is removed rather than merely no longer being searched for.
Evidence: Turn 20 shows scan_hits include “ICML” for paper2 and paper3, but subsequent scans (turn 22/25) do not include a plain “ICML” needle (they only check “ICML Workshop on Machine Learning for Audio”), so it is not confirmed whether “ICML” text remains or whether it is benign (e.g., in references).
Trajectory location: turn 20–22 verification strategy
